_note: Shared test vectors for tiered fan-out over FCM topics (doc 06 §4.3, doc 10 §6.3). backend/worker/src/tiers.ts and core/domain/Tiers.kt must both produce exactly these conditions. Rules: topic = '{up|di|dv}_{areaCode}_{GROUP}'. Groups are listed in the canonical order of blood-compatibility.json 'groups'. A condition holds at most 5 topics joined by ' || '. 'tiers' lists every tier that sends something, in escalation order; empty tiers are skipped. Tier 1: exact group, upazila. Tier 2: the other accepted groups, upazila (only with acceptCompatible). Tier 3: exact group, district. Tier 4: accepted groups (or exact) in each neighbouring district, plus the other accepted groups in the own district; Rh-negative uses the whole division instead. Rh-negative requests, and requests without an upazila, start at tier 3.
